english_text: Patients lost to follow-up should be traced and re-engaged in care as soon as possible.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba khaolitseng ho tla kalafo ba lokela ho batloa le ho khutlisetsoa tlhokomelong ea bophelo bo botle kapele kamoo ho ka khonehang.

english_text: TB treatment outcomes are worse in patients who are HIV-positive, malnourished, or have drug-resistant TB.
sesotho_text: Kalafo ea lefuba e ba le liphetho tse mpe ho bakuli ba phelang le HIV, ba sa fumaneng phepo e nepahetseng, kapa ba nang le lefuba le sa foleng ka meriana e tloaelehileng.

english_text: Sputum conversion — the change from a positive to a negative sputum culture — is a key indicator of treatment response.
sesotho_text: Ha tlhahlobo ea sekhohlela e fetoha ho tloha ho e bontšang lefuba ho ea ho e sa le bontšeng, sena ke sesupo sa bohlokoa sa hore kalafo ea lefuba e ea sebetsa.

english_text: End-of-treatment sputum culture is used to confirm TB cure.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea sekhohlela e etsoang qetellong ea kalafo e thusa ho netefatsa hore mokuli o folile lefubeng.

english_text: Post-TB lung disease — persistent respiratory impairment after TB treatment — affects many TB survivors.
sesotho_text: Lefu la matšoafo kamora lefuba, ho tsoela pele ha mathata a ho hema le kamora hore kalafo ea lefuba e phethoe, le ama batho ba bangata ba kileng ba tšoaroa ke lefuba.

english_text: TB treatment in children uses weight-based dosing of the same first-line drugs used in adults.
sesotho_text: Bana ba tšoeroeng ke lefuba ba fuoa meriana e tšoanang le ea batho ba baholo, empa palo ea meriana e itšetlehile ka boima ba 'mele ba ngoana.

english_text: Child-friendly TB drug formulations such as dispersible tablets improve dosing accuracy in young children.
sesotho_text: Matlapa a lefuba a etselitsoeng bana, a qhibilihang metsing habonolo, a thusa hore bana ba fumane palo e nepahetseng ea meriana.

english_text: TB meningitis in children requires a longer treatment duration of at least nine to twelve months.
sesotho_text: Ha ngoana a e-na le lefuba la boko (TB meningitis), o lokela ho noa meriana nako e telele, bonyane likhoeli tse 9 ho isa ho tse 12.

english_text: Corticosteroids are used alongside TB treatment for TB meningitis and pericarditis to reduce inflammation.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea corticosteroid e fuoa bakuli hammoho le meriana ea lefuba ha ba e-na le TB meningitis kapa pericarditis, e le ho fokotsa ho ruruha.

english_text: Children with TB should be assessed for nutritional status and provided with nutritional support.
sesotho_text: Bana ba tšoeroeng ke lefuba ba lokela ho hlahlojoa hore na ba fumana phepo e nepahetseng, 'me ba thusoe ka lijo kapa phepo e matlafatsang bophelo ba bona.

english_text: Parents and caregivers must be educated about the importance of completing TB treatment in their children.
sesotho_text: Batsoali le bahlokomeli ba lokela ho ruteloa bohlokoa ba hore bana ba qete meriana ea lefuba ka botlalo.

english_text: Household contacts of a child with TB should be screened for TB and latent TB infection.
sesotho_text: Batho ba lulang le ngoana ea tšoeroeng ke lefuba ba lokela ho hlahlojoa ho bona hore na ba na le lefuba kapa tšoaetso ea lefuba e so hlahise matšoao.

english_text: Children under five who are household contacts of a TB case should receive TB preventive therapy.
sesotho_text: Bana ba ka tlase ho lilemo tse 5 ba lulang le motho ea tšoeroeng ke lefuba ba lokela ho fuoa meriana e thusang ho thibela hore ba tšoaroe ke lefuba.

english_text: TB in adolescents is often under-diagnosed because symptoms may be attributed to other causes.
sesotho_text: Hangata lefuba ho bacha ha le fumanoe kapele hobane matšoao a lona a ka ferekanngoa le a mafu a mang

english_text: Adolescents with TB face unique challenges including school disruption, stigma, and adherence difficulties.
sesotho_text: Bacha ba tšoeroeng ke lefuba ba ka ba le mathata a kang ho fetoa ke sekolo, ho khetholloa ke batho, le ho thatafalloa ke ho noa meriana ka nepo.

english_text: Pregnant women with TB should be treated immediately as untreated TB poses greater risk than the drugs.
sesotho_text: Mosali ea moimana ea nang le lefuba o lokela ho fumana kalafo kapele, hobane ho se phekole lefuba ho kotsi ho feta ho noa meriana ea lona.

english_text: Streptomycin should not be used in pregnant women due to the risk of foetal ototoxicity.
sesotho_text: Basali ba bakhachane ha baa lokela ho fuoa Streptomycin hobane e ka senya kutlo ea lesea le ntseng le hōla ka pōpelong.

english_text: Breastfeeding is safe for women on standard first-line TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Ho anyesa ho bolokehile ho basali ba noang meriana e tloaelehileng ea mantlha ea kalafo ea lefuba (TB).

english_text: Elderly patients may require dose adjustments of TB drugs due to reduced kidney and liver function.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba hōlileng ba ka ’na ba hloka ho fetoleloa litekanyetso tsa meriana ea TB ka lebaka la ho fokotseha ha tšebetso ea liphio le sebete.

english_text: Patients with chronic liver disease require careful monitoring and possible drug substitutions during TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba nang le lefu le sa foleng la sebete ba hloka ho behiloe leihlo ka hloko le mohlomong ho nkeloa meriana e meng sebaka nakong ea kalafo ea TB.

english_text: Patients with chronic kidney disease may need dose adjustments for renally cleared TB drugs.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba nang le lefu le sa foleng la liphio ba ka ’na ba hloka ho fetoleloa litekanyetso tsa meriana ea TB e ntšoang ke liphio.

english_text: Diabetic patients on TB treatment should have their blood glucose monitored closely.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba nang le lefu la tsoekere ba leng kalafong ea TB ba lokela ho behiloe leihlo ka hloko boemo ba tsoekere maling.

english_text: Rifampicin reduces the effectiveness of oral contraceptives; women should use alternative contraception.
sesotho_text: Rifampicin e fokotsa katleho ea lithibela-pelehi tse nooang; basali ba lokela ho sebelisa mokhoa o mong oa thibelo ea bokhachane.

english_text: TB patients who use alcohol should be counselled about the increased risk of liver toxicity.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba noang joala ba lokela ho eletsoa ka kotsi e eketsehileng ea chefo sebeteng.

english_text: Patients on antiretroviral therapy and TB treatment simultaneously require careful management of drug interactions.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba leng kalafong ea li-antiretroviral le kalafong ea TB ka nako e tšoanang ba hloka taolo e hlokolosi ea ho sebelisana ha meriana.

english_text: Rifampicin significantly reduces plasma levels of many antiretroviral drugs including protease inhibitors.
sesotho_text: Rifampicin e fokotsa haholo maemo a meriana e mengata ea li-antiretroviral maling, ho kenyeletsa le li-protease inhibitors.

english_text: Efavirenz is the preferred NNRTI for use with rifampicin-containing TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Efavirenz ke NNRTI e ratoang bakeng sa tšebeliso hammoho le kalafo ea TB e nang le rifampicin.

english_text: Dolutegravir dose adjustment may be required when used with rifampicin.
sesotho_text: Ho ka ’na ha hlokahala ho fetola tekanyetso ea dolutegravir ha e sebelisoa hammoho le rifampicin.

english_text: Rifampicin reduces warfarin levels; anticoagulation should be monitored carefully.
sesotho_text: Rifampicin e fokotsa maemo a warfarin maling; ho thibela ho hoama ha mali ho lokela ho behiloe leihlo ka hloko.

english_text: Rifampicin can reduce the effectiveness of methadone, requiring dose increases in patients on opioid substitution therapy.
sesotho_text: Rifampicin e ka fokotsa katleho ea methadone, e leng se ka hlokang ho eketsoa ha tekanyetso ho bakuli ba leng kalafong ea ho nkela li-opioid sebaka.

english_text: Isoniazid inhibits the metabolism of phenytoin, potentially causing phenytoin toxicity.
sesotho_text: Isoniazid e sitisa ho senyeha ha phenytoin ’meleng, e leng se ka bakang chefo ea phenytoin.

english_text: Patients on TB treatment should inform all their healthcare providers about their medications.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba leng kalafong ea TB ba lokela ho tsebisa bafani bohle ba bona ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo ka meriana eo ba e sebelisang.

english_text: A pharmacist review of all medications is recommended when starting TB treatment in patients on multiple drugs.
sesotho_text: Ho khothaletsoa hore rakhemisi a hlahlobe meriana eohle ha ho qalisoa kalafo ea TB ho bakuli ba sebelisang meriana e mengata.

english_text: Antacids containing aluminium or magnesium can reduce the absorption of some TB drugs.
sesotho_text: Li-antacid tse nang le aluminium kapa magnesium li ka fokotsa ho monyela ha meriana e meng ea TB ’meleng.

english_text: TB drugs should be taken at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea TB e lokela ho nooa ka nako e tšoanang letsatsi le leng le le leng ho boloka maemo a meriana maling a tsitsitse.

english_text: Sputum smear and culture should be repeated monthly during TB treatment to monitor response.
sesotho_text: Teko ea sekhohlela ka smear le culture e lokela ho phetoa khoeli le khoeli nakong ea kalafo ea TB ho hlahloba karabelo kalafong.

english_text: Liver function tests should be performed at baseline and repeated if symptoms of hepatotoxicity develop.
sesotho_text: Liteko tsa tšebetso ea sebete li lokela ho etsoa qalong ea kalafo ’me li phetoe haeba matšoao a chefo sebeteng a hlaha.

english_text: Visual acuity testing should be performed before and during ethambutol treatment.
sesotho_text: Teko ea bokhoni ba pono e lokela ho etsoa pele le nakong ea kalafo ka ethambutol.

english_text: Weight should be monitored monthly during TB treatment; weight gain is a sign of treatment response.
sesotho_text: Boima ba ’mele bo lokela ho behoa leihlo khoeli le khoeli nakong ea kalafo ea TB; ho nona ke pontšo ea karabelo kalafong.

english_text: Clinical review at each visit should include assessment of adherence, side effects, and treatment response.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea bongaka ketelong ka ’ngoe e lokela ho kenyelletsa ho lekola ho latela kalafo, litla-morao, le karabelo kalafong.

english_text: Chest X-ray may be repeated at the end of treatment to assess radiological improvement.
sesotho_text: X-ray ea sefuba e ka phetoa qetellong ea kalafo ho lekola ntlafalo e bonahalang litšoantšong tsa bongaka

english_text: Audiometry should be performed in patients receiving aminoglycosides for drug-resistant TB.
sesotho_text: Teko ea kutlo e lokela ho etsoa ho bakuli ba fumanang li-aminoglycoside bakeng sa TB e hananang le meriana.

english_text: Electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring is required for patients on bedaquiline or delamanid due to QT prolongation risk.
sesotho_text: Ho beha leihlo ka electrocardiogram (ECG) hoa hlokahala ho bakuli ba sebelisang bedaquiline kapa delamanid ka lebaka la kotsi ea ho lelefatsa QT.

english_text: Serum potassium and magnesium should be monitored in patients on bedaquiline.
sesotho_text: Maemo a potassium le magnesium maling a lokela ho behoa leihlo ho bakuli ba sebelisang bedaquiline.

english_text: Patients should be asked about adherence at every visit using non-judgmental, open-ended questions.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba lokela ho botsoa ka ho latela kalafo ketelong ka ’ngoe ho sebelisoa lipotso tse bulehileng le tse sa ahloleng.

english_text: Taking so many tablets every day was hard at first, but I got used to it.
sesotho_text: Ho noa lipilisi tse ngata hakana letsatsi le letsatsi ho ne ho le thata qalong, empa ke ile ka ho tloaela.

english_text: My urine turned orange and I was scared, but the nurse explained it was normal with the medication.
sesotho_text: Moroto oa ka o ile oa fetoha oa lamunu ’me ke ile ka tšoha, empa mooki a ntlhalosetsa hore ho tloaelehile ka lebaka la moriana.

english_text: I felt nauseous every morning after taking my TB tablets, so I started eating before taking them.
sesotho_text: Ke ne ke ikutloa ke nyekeloa ke pelo hoseng ho hong le ho hong ka mor’a ho noa lipilisi tsa ka tsa TB, kahoo ka qala ho ja pele ke li noa.

english_text: After two months of treatment I started feeling much better and my cough went away.
sesotho_text: Ka mor’a likhoeli tse peli tsa kalafo ke ile ka qala ho ikutloa ke le betere haholo, ’me khohlela ea ka ea fela.

english_text: I was worried about losing my job while on TB treatment because I had to attend the clinic so often.
sesotho_text: Ke ne ke tšoenyehile ka ho lahleheloa ke mosebetsi ha ke ntse ke le kalafong ea TB, hobane ke ne ke tlameha ho ea tleliniking khafetsa.

english_text: My family supported me every day by reminding me to take my medication.
sesotho_text: Lelapa la ka le ile la ntšehetsa letsatsi le leng le le leng ka ho nkhopotsa ho noa meriana ea ka.

english_text: I completed all six months of treatment and the doctor told me I was cured.
sesotho_text: Ke qetile likhoeli tsohle tse tšeletseng tsa kalafo, ’me ngaka ea mpolella hore ke folile.

english_text: There were days when I wanted to stop taking the tablets because I felt better, but I remembered what the nurse said.
sesotho_text: Ho ne ho e-na le matsatsi ao ke neng ke batla ho khaotsa ho noa lipilisi hobane ke ne ke ikutloa ke le betere, empa ka hopola seo mooki a neng a se buile.

english_text: The community health worker visited me every week to make sure I was taking my medication.
sesotho_text: Mosebeletsi oa bophelo bo botle sechabeng o ne a nketela beke le beke ho netefatsa hore ke noa meriana ea ka.

english_text: I am grateful that TB treatment is free at the government clinic.
sesotho_text: Ke leboha hore kalafo ea TB ke mahala tleliniking ea ’muso.

english_text: National TB programmes are responsible for ensuring uninterrupted supply of quality-assured TB drugs.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a naha a TB a ikarabella ho netefatsa phepelo e sa khaotseng ea meriana ea TB e netefalitsoeng boleng.

english_text: TB drug stockouts at facility level are a major cause of treatment interruption.
sesotho_text: Ho haella ha meriana ea TB setsing sa bophelo ke sesosa se seholo sa ho sitisoa ha kalafo.

english_text: Patient-centred TB care places the needs and preferences of the patient at the centre of service delivery.
sesotho_text: Tlhokomelo ea TB e shebaneng le mokuli e beha litlhoko le likhetho tsa mokuli bohareng ba phano ea litšebeletso.

english_text: TB treatment should be free of charge to all patients in public health facilities.
sesotho_text: Kalafo ea TB e lokela ho ba mahala ho bakuli bohle litsing tsa bophelo tsa sechaba.

english_text: TB treatment cards and registers are essential tools for tracking patient progress and outcomes.
sesotho_text: Likarete tsa kalafo ea TB le lirejistara ke lisebelisoa tsa bohlokoa bakeng sa ho latela tsoelo-pele le liphetho tsa bakuli.

english_text: Electronic TB registers improve data quality and enable real-time monitoring of treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Lirejistara tsa TB tsa elektroniki li ntlafatsa boleng ba data ’me li nolofalletsa ho beha leihlo liphetho tsa kalafo ka nako ea sebele.

english_text: TB programme performance is measured using standard WHO treatment outcome definitions.
sesotho_text: Ts'ebetso ea lenaneo la TB e lekanyetsoa ho sebelisoa litlhaloso tse tloaelehileng tsa WHO tsa liphetho tsa kalafo.

english_text: Quarterly cohort analysis of TB treatment outcomes helps programmes identify gaps and improve performance.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea kotara ea lihlopha tsa bakuli mabapi le liphetho tsa kalafo ea TB e thusa mananeo ho tseba likheo le ho ntlafatsa ts'ebetso.

english_text: Community TB care models have been shown to achieve treatment success rates comparable to facility-based care.
sesotho_text: Mehlala ea tlhokomelo ea TB sechabeng e bontšitsoe hore e ka fihlela litekanyetso tsa katleho ea kalafo tse bapisoang le tlhokomelo e fanoang setsing sa bophelo.

english_text: Integration of TB and HIV services improves access and outcomes for patients with both conditions.
sesotho_text: Kopanyo ea litšebeletso tsa TB le HIV e ntlafatsa phihlello le liphetho bakeng sa bakuli ba nang le maemo ana ka bobeli.

english_text: Drug-resistant TB occurs when TB bacteria develop resistance to one or more anti-TB drugs.
sesotho_text: TB e hananang le meriana e hlaha ha libaktheria tsa TB li e-ba le ho hana moriana o le mong kapa e mengata ea TB.

english_text: Multidrug-resistant TB (MDR-TB) is resistant to at least isoniazid and rifampicin.
sesotho_text: TB e hananang le meriana e mengata (MDR-TB) e hanana bonyane le isoniazid le rifampicin.

english_text: Rifampicin-resistant TB (RR-TB) is treated the same as MDR-TB.
sesotho_text: TB e hananang le rifampicin (RR-TB) e phekoloa ka tsela e tšoanang le MDR-TB.

english_text: Pre-extensively drug-resistant TB (pre-XDR-TB) is MDR/RR-TB with additional resistance to fluoroquinolones.
sesotho_text: TB e batlang e hanana haholo le meriana (pre-XDR-TB) ke MDR/RR-TB e nang le ho hanana ho eketsehileng le li-fluoroquinolone.

english_text: Extensively drug-resistant TB (XDR-TB) is MDR-TB with resistance to fluoroquinolones and at least one Group A drug.
sesotho_text: TB e hananang haholo le meriana (XDR-TB) ke MDR-TB e hananang le li-fluoroquinolone le bonyane moriana o le mong oa Sehlopha sa A.

english_text: Drug-resistant TB is caused by inadequate treatment, poor adherence, or transmission of resistant strains.
sesotho_text: TB e hananang le meriana e bakoa ke kalafo e sa lekanang, ho se latele kalafo hantle, kapa phetiso ea mefuta ea TB e seng e hanana le meriana.

english_text: Drug-resistant TB is harder to treat, more expensive, and has worse outcomes than drug-sensitive TB.
sesotho_text: TB e hananang le meriana e thata haholo ho e phekola, e bitsa chelete e ngata, ’me e na le liphetho tse mpe ho feta TB e utloang meriana.

english_text: MDR-TB treatment requires longer regimens using second-line drugs that are more toxic and costly.
sesotho_text: Kalafo ea MDR-TB e hloka meralo ea kalafo e telele e sebelisang meriana ea mokhahlelo oa bobeli e nang le chefo e ngata haholoanyane ebile e bitsa chelete e ngata.

english_text: The BPaL regimen — bedaquiline, pretomanid, and linezolid — is a newer shorter regimen for XDR-TB.
sesotho_text: Moralo oa kalafo oa BPaL — bedaquiline, pretomanid, le linezolid — ke moralo o mocha o mokhuts’oane oa kalafo bakeng sa XDR-TB.

english_text: The BPaLM regimen adds moxifloxacin to BPaL and is used for pre-XDR-TB.
sesotho_text: Moralo oa kalafo oa BPaLM o eketsa moxifloxacin ho BPaL ’me o sebelisoa bakeng sa pre-XDR-TB.

english_text: Bedaquiline is a diarylquinoline antibiotic that inhibits mycobacterial ATP synthase.
sesotho_text: Bedaquiline ke sebolaya-mafu sa diarylquinoline se thibelang ATP synthase ea mycobacteria.

english_text: Delamanid is a nitroimidazole drug used in the treatment of MDR-TB.
sesotho_text: Delamanid ke moriana oa nitroimidazole o sebelisoang kalafong ea MDR-TB.

english_text: Linezolid is an oxazolidinone antibiotic used in MDR-TB regimens but carries significant toxicity risks.
sesotho_text: Linezolid ke sebolaya-mafu sa oxazolidinone se sebelisoang meralong ea kalafo ea MDR-TB, empa se na le likotsi tse kholo tsa chefo.

english_text: Clofazimine is a riminophenazine antibiotic used in MDR-TB treatment regimens.
sesotho_text: Clofazimine ke sebolaya-mafu sa riminophenazine se sebelisoang meralong ea kalafo ea MDR-TB.

english_text: Fluoroquinolones such as moxifloxacin and levofloxacin are key drugs in MDR-TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Li-fluoroquinolone tse kang moxifloxacin le levofloxacin ke meriana ea bohlokoa kalafong ea MDR-TB.

english_text: The 6-month BPaL/BPaLM regimen represents a major advance in shortening MDR-TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Moralo oa kalafo oa likhoeli tse 6 oa BPaL/BPaLM o emela tsoelo-pele e kholo ho khutsufatseng kalafo ea MDR-TB.

english_text: Older MDR-TB regimens lasted 18 to 24 months and were associated with high rates of side effects.
sesotho_text: Meralo ea khale ea kalafo ea MDR-TB e ne e nka likhoeli tse 18 ho isa ho tse 24 ’me e ne e amahanngoa le litekanyetso tse phahameng tsa litla-morao.

english_text: Injectable aminoglycosides such as amikacin and kanamycin are no longer recommended in MDR-TB regimens due to toxicity.
sesotho_text: Li-aminoglycoside tse entoang tse kang amikacin le kanamycin ha li sa khothalletsoa meralong ea kalafo ea MDR-TB ka lebaka la chefo.

english_text: Drug susceptibility testing is essential before starting MDR-TB treatment to guide drug selection.
sesotho_text: Teko ea kutloisiso ea meriana e bohlokoa pele ho qala kalafo ea MDR-TB ho tataisa khetho ea meriana.

english_text: MDR-TB patients should be managed by or in consultation with a specialist TB team.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba MDR-TB ba lokela ho hlokomeloa ke kapa ka boeletsi ba sehlopha se khethehileng sa litsebi tsa TB.

english_text: Linezolid can cause peripheral neuropathy, optic neuritis, and bone marrow suppression.
sesotho_text: Linezolid e ka baka neuropathy ea methapo e ka thōko, ho ruruha ha methapo ea mahlo, le khatello ea moko oa masapo.

english_text: Bedaquiline prolongs the QT interval and requires regular ECG monitoring.
sesotho_text: Bedaquiline e lelefatsa nako ea QT ’me e hloka tlhahlobo ea ECG khafetsa.

english_text: Clofazimine causes skin discolouration ranging from red-brown to black, which is reversible after stopping the drug.
sesotho_text: Clofazimine e baka phetoho ea ’mala oa letlalo ho tloha ho bofubelu bo sootho ho ea ho botšo, e ka khutlelang setloaeling ka mor’a ho emisa moriana.

english_text: Moxifloxacin can cause QT prolongation and should be used with caution with other QT-prolonging drugs.
sesotho_text: Moxifloxacin e ka baka ho lelefala ha nako ea QT ’me e lokela ho sebelisoa ka hloko hammoho le meriana e meng e lelefatsang QT.

english_text: Psychiatric side effects including depression and psychosis can occur with cycloserine.
sesotho_text: Litla-morao tsa kelello, ho kenyeletsa khatello ea maikutlo le psychosis, li ka hlaha ka cycloserine.

english_text: Hearing loss from aminoglycosides is often permanent and can be devastating for patients.
sesotho_text: Ho lahleheloa ke kutlo ka lebaka la li-aminoglycoside hangata ho ba ha ka ho sa feleng ’me ho ka ba kotsi haholo ho bakuli.

english_text: Patients on MDR-TB treatment require intensive monitoring for drug toxicity and treatment response.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba leng kalafong ea MDR-TB ba hloka ho behwa leihlo ka hloko haholo bakeng sa chefo ea meriana le karabelo kalafong.

english_text: Monthly sputum cultures are essential for monitoring MDR-TB treatment response.
sesotho_text: Litloaelo tsa sekhohlela tsa khoeli le khoeli li bohlokoa bakeng sa ho beha leihlo karabelo ea kalafo ea MDR-TB.

english_text: Palliative care should be offered to patients with untreatable drug-resistant TB.
sesotho_text: Tlhokomelo ea ho kokobetsa bohloko e lokela ho fuoa bakuli ba nang le TB e hananang le meriana e sa phekoleheng.

english_text: Psychosocial support is critical for MDR-TB patients who face long, difficult treatment courses.
sesotho_text: Tšehetso ea kelello le ea sechaba e bohlokoa haholo ho bakuli ba MDR-TB ba tobaneng le meralo ea kalafo e melelele le e boima.

english_text: In 2023, approximately 410,000 people developed MDR/RR-TB globally.
sesotho_text: Ka 2023, batho ba ka bang 410,000 lefatšeng ka bophara ba ile ba tšoaroa ke MDR/RR-TB.

english_text: Only about 4 in 10 people with MDR-TB are currently diagnosed and enrolled on treatment.
sesotho_text: Ke batho ba ka bang 4 ho ba 10 feela ba nang le MDR-TB bao hajoale ba hlahlojoang ’me ba kenngoa kalafong.

english_text: The MDR-TB treatment success rate globally is approximately 63%.
sesotho_text: Sekhahla sa katleho ea kalafo ea MDR-TB lefatšeng ka bophara se ka ba 63%.

english_text: Preventing drug resistance requires ensuring every TB patient completes their full course of treatment.
sesotho_text: Ho thibela ho hanana le meriana ho hloka ho netefatsa hore mokuli e mong le e mong oa TB o qeta moralo oa hae o feletseng oa kalafo.

english_text: Prescribing incorrect TB drug regimens is a major driver of acquired drug resistance.
sesotho_text: Ho laela meralo e fosahetseng ea meriana ea TB ke sesosa se seholo sa ho hlaha ha ho hanana le meriana ho fumanoang nakong ea kalafo.

english_text: Poor quality TB drugs can contribute to treatment failure and the development of drug resistance.
sesotho_text: Meriana ea TB ea boleng bo bobe e ka kenya letsoho ho hloleheng ha kalafo le ho hlaha ha ho hanana le meriana.

english_text: Infection control measures in health facilities reduce nosocomial transmission of drug-resistant TB.
sesotho_text: Mehato ea taolo ea tšoaetso litsing tsa bophelo e fokotsa phetiso ea TB e hananang le meriana e fumanoang litsing tsa tlhokomelo ea bophelo.

english_text: Contact investigation for MDR-TB cases should include drug susceptibility testing of any secondary cases.
sesotho_text: Patlisiso ea batho ba kileng ba kopana le linyeoe tsa MDR-TB e lokela ho kenyelletsa tlhahlobo ea kutlo ea meriana ho linyeoe leha e le life tsa bobeli.

english_text: TB preventive therapy with isoniazid does not prevent MDR-TB in contacts of MDR-TB patients.
sesotho_text: Kalafo ea thibelo ea TB ka isoniazid ha e thibele MDR-TB ho batho ba kileng ba kopana le bakuli ba MDR-TB.

english_text: Shorter MDR-TB preventive therapy regimens for contacts of MDR-TB patients are under investigation.
sesotho_text: Meralo e mekhutšoanyane ea kalafo ea thibelo ea MDR-TB bakeng sa batho ba kileng ba kopana le bakuli ba MDR-TB e ntse e etsoa lipatlisiso.

english_text: People living with HIV are 18 times more likely to develop active TB than HIV-negative people.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba na le monyetla o moholo ka makhetlo a 18 oa ho tšoaroa ke TB e sebetsang ho feta batho ba se nang HIV.

english_text: HIV weakens the immune system, making it unable to control latent TB infection.
sesotho_text: HIV e fokolisa sesole sa ’mele, e etsa hore se sitoe ho laola tšoaetso ea TB e patiloeng.

english_text: All HIV-positive patients should be screened for TB at every clinical visit.
sesotho_text: Bakuli bohle ba nang le HIV ba lokela ho hlahlojoa bakeng sa TB ketelong e ’ngoe le e ’ngoe ea kliniki.

english_text: All TB patients should be offered HIV testing at the time of TB diagnosis.
sesotho_text: Bakuli bohle ba TB ba lokela ho fuoa tlhahlobo ea HIV nakong eo ba fumanoang ba e-na le TB.

english_text: HIV-positive TB patients should start ART as soon as possible after beginning TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba nang le HIV ba lokela ho qala ART kapele kamoo ho ka khonehang ka mor’a ho qala kalafo ea TB.

english_text: ART should be started within two weeks of TB treatment initiation in most HIV-positive TB patients.
sesotho_text: ART e lokela ho qalisoa nakong ea libeke tse peli ho tloha ha kalafo ea TB e qalisoa ho bakuli ba bangata ba TB ba nang le HIV.

english_text: In TB meningitis co-infected patients, ART initiation should be delayed to reduce immune reconstitution risk.
sesotho_text: Ho bakuli ba nang le TB meningitis ba nang le tšoaetso e kopaneng, ho qala ART ho lokela ho liehisoa ho fokotsa kotsi ea immune reconstitution.

english_text: Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS) can occur when ART is started in TB/HIV patients.
sesotho_text: Lefu la ho ruruha le bakoang ke ho tsosolosoa ha sesole sa ’mele (IRIS) le ka hlaha ha ART e qalisoa ho bakuli ba nang le TB/HIV.

english_text: TB-IRIS presents as worsening TB symptoms shortly after starting ART despite effective TB treatment.
sesotho_text: TB-IRIS e bonahala ka ho mpefala ha matšoao a TB nakoana ka mor’a ho qala ART, leha kalafo ea TB e sebetsa hantle.

english_text: Paradoxical TB-IRIS is managed with corticosteroids in severe cases.
sesotho_text: Paradoxical TB-IRIS e laoloa ka li-corticosteroid maemong a matla.

english_text: Unmasking TB-IRIS occurs when ART reveals previously subclinical TB disease.
sesotho_text: Unmasking TB-IRIS e etsahala ha ART e senola lefu la TB le neng le sa bonahale pele ka matšoao.

english_text: HIV-positive TB patients have higher rates of treatment failure, relapse, and death than HIV-negative TB patients.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba nang le HIV ba na le litekanyetso tse phahameng tsa ho hloleha ha kalafo, ho khutla ha lefu, le lefu ho feta bakuli ba TB ba se nang HIV.

english_text: Cotrimoxazole preventive therapy should be given to all HIV-positive TB patients.
sesotho_text: Kalafo ea thibelo ka cotrimoxazole e lokela ho fuoa bakuli bohle ba TB ba nang le HIV.

english_text: TB/HIV co-infected patients benefit from integrated care at a single facility.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba nang le tšoaetso e kopaneng ea TB/HIV ba rua molemo tlhokomelong e kopaneng setsing se le seng.

english_text: Efavirenz-based ART is preferred for HIV-positive TB patients on rifampicin-containing treatment.
sesotho_text: ART e thehiloeng ho efavirenz e khethoa bakeng sa bakuli ba TB ba nang le HIV ba leng kalafong e nang le rifampicin.

english_text: Dolutegravir 50mg twice daily can be used with rifampicin in TB/HIV co-infected patients.
sesotho_text: Dolutegravir 50 mg habeli ka letsatsi e ka sebelisoa le rifampicin ho bakuli ba nang le tšoaetso e kopaneng ea TB/HIV.

english_text: Protease inhibitor-based ART regimens should not be used with rifampicin due to significant drug interactions.
sesotho_text: Meralo ea ART e thehiloeng ho protease inhibitor ha ea lokela ho sebelisoa le rifampicin ka lebaka la litšebelisano tse kholo tsa meriana.

english_text: HIV-positive patients with TB have a higher risk of developing drug-resistant TB.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba nang le HIV ba nang le TB ba na le kotsi e phahameng ea ho ba le TB e hananang le meriana.

english_text: Viral load suppression in HIV-positive TB patients improves TB treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho hatelloa ha bongata ba kokoana-hloko maling ho bakuli ba TB ba nang le HIV ho ntlafatsa liphetho tsa kalafo ea TB.

english_text: TB preventive therapy (TPT) reduces the risk of latent TB progressing to active TB disease.
sesotho_text: Kalafo ea thibelo ea TB (TPT) e fokotsa kotsi ea hore TB e ipatileng e tsoele pele ho ba lefu la TB le sebetsang.

english_text: All HIV-positive people without active TB should be offered TB preventive therapy.
sesotho_text: Batho bohle ba nang le HIV ba se nang TB e sebetsang ba lokela ho fuoa kalafo ea thibelo ea TB.

english_text: The 6-month isoniazid preventive therapy (6H) regimen is the most widely used TPT option.
sesotho_text: Moralo oa kalafo ea thibelo ka isoniazid oa likhoeli tse 6 (6H) ke khetho ea TPT e sebelisoang haholo ka ho fetisisa.

english_text: The 3-month weekly isoniazid and rifapentine (3HP) regimen is a shorter effective TPT option.
sesotho_text: Moralo oa likhoeli tse 3 oa isoniazid le rifapentine tse fuoang hang ka beke (3HP) ke khetho e khuts’oane le e sebetsang ea TPT.

english_text: The 1-month daily isoniazid and rifapentine (1HP) regimen is the shortest approved TPT option.
sesotho_text: Moralo oa khoeli e 1 oa isoniazid le rifapentine tse nooang letsatsi le letsatsi (1HP) ke khetho ea TPT e khuts’oane ka ho fetisisa e amohetsoeng.

english_text: The 3-month daily isoniazid and rifampicin (3HR) regimen is another short TPT option.
sesotho_text: Moralo oa likhoeli tse 3 oa isoniazid le rifampicin tse nooang letsatsi le letsatsi (3HR) ke khetho e ’ngoe e khuts’oane ea TPT.

english_text: Active TB must be ruled out before starting TB preventive therapy.
sesotho_text: TB e sebetsang e lokela ho qheleloa ka thōko pele ho qalisoa kalafo ea thibelo ea TB.

english_text: Household contacts of TB patients, especially children under five, should receive TB preventive therapy.
sesotho_text: Batho ba lulang le bakuli ba TB ka tlung e le ’ngoe, haholo-holo bana ba ka tlase ho lilemo tse hlano, ba lokela ho fumana kalafo ea thibelo ea TB.

english_text: TPT uptake among eligible HIV-positive patients remains low in many high-burden countries.
sesotho_text: Kamohelo ea TPT har’a bakuli ba nang le HIV ba tšoanelehang e ntse e le tlase linaheng tse ngata tse nang le moroalo o phahameng oa TB.

english_text: Pyridoxine supplementation is recommended for all patients on isoniazid-containing TPT regimens.
sesotho_text: Tlatsetso ea pyridoxine e khothaletsoa bakeng sa bakuli bohle ba meralong ea TPT e nang le isoniazid.

english_text: TB in pregnancy is associated with increased risk of maternal mortality, preterm birth, and low birth weight.
sesotho_text: TB nakong ea bokhachane e amahanngoa le kotsi e eketsehileng ea lefu la ’mè, ho beleha pele ho nako, le lesea le hlahang le le boima bo tlase.

english_text: Untreated TB in pregnancy poses a greater risk to the mother and baby than TB treatment.
sesotho_text: TB e sa phekoloang nakong ea bokhachane e beha ’mè le lesea kotsing e kholo ho feta kalafo ea TB.

english_text: Standard first-line TB treatment is safe and recommended for pregnant women.
sesotho_text: Kalafo e tloaelehileng ea pele ea TB e bolokehile ebile e khothaletsoa bakeng sa basali ba bakhachane.

english_text: Pregnant women with TB should be monitored closely for drug toxicity and foetal wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Basali ba bakhachane ba nang le TB ba lokela ho beoa leihlo haufi-ufi bakeng sa chefo ea meriana le bophelo bo botle ba lesea le ka popelong.

english_text: Congenital TB — TB transmitted from mother to baby in the womb — is rare but can be life-threatening.
sesotho_text: TB ea tsoalo — TB e fetisoang ho tloha ho ’mè ho ea ho lesea le ka popelong — e etsahala ka seoelo empa e ka beha bophelo kotsing.

english_text: Newborns of mothers with active TB at delivery should be evaluated for congenital TB.
sesotho_text: Masea a sa tsoa tsoaloa ke bo-’mè ba nang le TB e sebetsang nakong ea pelehi a lokela ho hlahlojoa bakeng sa TB ea tsoalo.

english_text: Newborns exposed to TB should receive isoniazid preventive therapy for six months.
sesotho_text: Masea a sa tsoa tsoaloa a pepeselitsoeng TB a lokela ho fuoa kalafo ea thibelo ka isoniazid likhoeli tse tšeletseng.

english_text: BCG vaccination should be delayed in newborns receiving isoniazid preventive therapy.
sesotho_text: Ente ea BCG e lokela ho chechisoa ho masea a sa tsoa tsoaloa a fumanang kalafo ea thibelo ka isoniazid.

english_text: Breastfeeding is encouraged in women on TB treatment as the benefits outweigh the risks.
sesotho_text: Ho anyesa ho khothaletsoa ho basali ba leng kalafong ea TB kaha melemo ea hona e feta likotsi.

english_text: TB screening should be part of routine antenatal care in high-burden settings.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea TB e lokela ho ba karolo ea tlhokomelo e tloaelehileng ea bakhachane libakeng tse nang le moroalo o phahameng oa TB.

english_text: TB infection control aims to reduce the risk of TB transmission in health facilities and communities.
sesotho_text: Taolo ea tšoaetso ea TB e ikemiselitse ho fokotsa kotsi ea phetiso ea TB litsing tsa bophelo bo botle le metseng.

english_text: Administrative controls are the most important component of TB infection control.
sesotho_text: Mehato ea tsamaiso ke karolo ea bohlokoa ka ho fetisisa ea taolo ea tšoaetso ea TB.

english_text: Fast-tracking TB suspects through triage reduces their time in waiting areas and limits exposure to others.
sesotho_text: Ho potlakisa batho ba belaelloang ba e-na le TB ka tlhophiso ea bakuli ho fokotsa nako eo ba e qetang libakeng tsa ho leta ’me ho fokotsa ho pepesehela ba bang.

english_text: Separating TB patients from other patients in health facilities reduces nosocomial transmission.
sesotho_text: Ho arola bakuli ba TB ho bakuli ba bang litsing tsa bophelo bo botle ho fokotsa phetiso ea tšoaetso e fumanoang setsing sa bophelo.

english_text: Natural ventilation through open windows and doors is a cost-effective TB infection control measure.
sesotho_text: Moea oa tlhaho ka lifensetere le mamati a bulehileng ke mohato oa taolo ea tšoaetso ea TB o sa jeleng chelete e ngata.

english_text: Mechanical ventilation systems can improve air exchange rates in high-risk clinical areas.
sesotho_text: Litsamaiso tsa moea o kenang le o tsoang ka mechini li ka ntlafatsa sekhahla sa phapanyetsano ea moea libakeng tsa kliniki tse kotsing e phahameng.

english_text: Healthcare workers should be trained in TB infection control procedures.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ba lokela ho koetlisetsoa mekhoa ea taolo ea tšoaetso ea TB.

english_text: Personal protective equipment including N95 respirators should be available to all healthcare workers caring for TB patients.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa tšireletso ea botho, ho kenyeletsa le limaske tsa N95, li lokela ho fumaneha ho basebetsi bohle ba tlhokomelo ea bophelo bo botle ba hlokomelang bakuli ba TB.

english_text: Cough etiquette — covering the mouth when coughing — reduces TB transmission in public spaces.
sesotho_text: Mekhoa e metle ea ho khohlela — ho koahela molomo ha motho a khohlela — e fokotsa phetiso ea TB libakeng tsa sechaba

english_text: TB patients should be educated about cough hygiene to protect their household contacts.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba lokela ho rutoa ka bohloeki ba ho khohlela ho sireletsa batho ba lulang le bona malapeng.

english_text: Diabetes mellitus is a major risk factor for TB and worsens TB treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Lefu la tsoekere ke sesosa se seholo sa kotsi bakeng sa TB ’me le mpefatsa liphetho tsa kalafo ea TB.

english_text: TB can worsen glycaemic control in diabetic patients, creating a bidirectional relationship.
sesotho_text: TB e ka mpefatsa taolo ea tsoekere maling ho bakuli ba nang le lefu la tsoekere, e leng se hlahisang kamano e mahlakore a mabeli.

english_text: All TB patients should be screened for diabetes mellitus at the time of diagnosis.
sesotho_text: Bakuli bohle ba TB ba lokela ho hlahlojoa bakeng sa lefu la tsoekere nakong eo ba fumanang tlhahlobo ea TB.

english_text: Renal TB can cause obstructive uropathy and progressive kidney damage if untreated.
sesotho_text: TB ea liphio e ka baka thibelo tsamaisong ea moroto le tšenyo e ntseng e mpefala ea liphio haeba e sa phekoloe.

english_text: Hepatitis B and C co-infection increases the risk of hepatotoxicity during TB treatment.
sesotho_text: Tšoaetso e kopaneng ea hepatitis B le C e eketsa kotsi ea chefo sebeteng nakong ea kalafo ea TB.

english_text: Malnutrition significantly increases TB risk and worsens treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Khaello ea phepo e nepahetseng e eketsa haholo kotsi ea TB ’me e mpefatsa liphetho tsa kalafo.

english_text: Nutritional rehabilitation alongside TB treatment improves weight gain and treatment success.
sesotho_text: Tsosoloso ea phepo e nepahetseng hammoho le kalafo ea TB e ntlafatsa ho nona le katleho ea kalafo.

english_text: Silicosis patients have a lifetime risk of TB that is 30 times higher than the general population.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba nang le silicosis ba na le kotsi ea bophelo bohle ea ho tšoaroa ke TB e phahameng ka makhetlo a 30 ho feta sechaba ka kakaretso.

english_text: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a common complication of post-TB lung disease.
sesotho_text: Lefu le sa foleng la thibelo ea matšoafo (COPD) ke bothata bo tloaelehileng ba lefu la matšoafo le hlahang ka mor’a TB.

english_text: Mental health disorders including depression are common in TB patients and require integrated management.
sesotho_text: Mathata a bophelo bo botle ba kelello, ho kenyeletsa khatello ea maikutlo, a tloaelehile ho bakuli ba TB ’me a hloka taolo e kopaneng.

english_text: TB stigma causes delays in care seeking, treatment interruption, and social isolation.
sesotho_text: Sekhobo sa TB se baka tieho ea ho batla tlhokomelo, ho sitisoa ha kalafo, le ho itšehla thajana sechabeng.

english_text: Many people with TB hide their diagnosis from family and employers due to fear of discrimination.
sesotho_text: Batho ba bangata ba nang le TB ba pata tlhahlobo ea bona ho ba lelapa le bahiri ka lebaka la tšabo ea khethollo.

english_text: TB stigma is rooted in historical associations of TB with poverty, weakness, and moral failure.
sesotho_text: Sekhobo sa TB se metse ka metso likamanong tsa histori tse hokahanyang TB le bofuma, bofokoli, le ho hloleha ha boitšoaro.

english_text: Community education campaigns can reduce TB stigma by promoting accurate information.
sesotho_text: Matšolo a thuto sechabeng a ka fokotsa sekhobo sa TB ka ho khothalletsa tlhahisoleseling e nepahetseng.

english_text: Healthcare workers should use non-stigmatising language when communicating with TB patients.
sesotho_text: Basebeletsi ba bophelo bo botle ba lokela ho sebelisa puo e sa bakeng sekhobo ha ba buisana le bakuli ba TB.

english_text: TB patients have the right to confidentiality and protection from discrimination.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba TB ba na le tokelo ea lekunutu le tšireletso khahlanong le khethollo.

english_text: Peer support from TB survivors can help newly diagnosed patients cope with stigma and treatment challenges.
sesotho_text: Tšehetso e tsoang ho batho ba kileng ba kula ke lefuba (TB) e ka thusa bakuli ba sa tsoa fumanoa ba na le lona ho mamella khesollo le mathata a phekolo.

english_text: TB can cause significant financial hardship due to loss of income and treatment costs.
sesotho_text: Lefuba (TB) le ka baka mathata a kholo a lichelete ka baka la tahlehelo ea moputso le ditsenyehelo tsa phekolo.

english_text: Social protection programmes can mitigate the economic impact of TB on patients and families.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a tšireletso ea sechaba a ka fokotsa mathata a moruo a bakoang ke lefuba (TB) ho bakuli le malapa a bona.

english_text: Addressing TB stigma requires engagement with communities, faith leaders, and media.
sesotho_text: Ho loantša khesollo ea lefuba (TB) ho hlokahala hore ho sebetsoe le lichaba, baetapele ba bolumeli, le mecha ea phatlalatso.

english_text: I was told my TB was resistant to the normal tablets and I would need different, stronger medication.
sesotho_text: Ke bolelletsoe hore lefuba (TB) la ka le hanana le lipilisi tse tloaelehileng, 'me ke tla hloka meriana e fapaneng e matla le ho feta.

english_text: The MDR-TB treatment made me very sick, but I kept going because I wanted to survive.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea lefuba le hanang meriana (MDR-TB) e ile ea nkulisa haholo, empa ke ile ka tsoela pele hobane ke ne ke batla ho phela.

english_text: I have both HIV and TB, and I take many tablets every day, but I am managing.
sesotho_text: Ke na le HIV le lefuba (TB), 'me ke noa lipilisi tse ngata letsatsi le letsatsi, empa kea khona ho iphedisa.

english_text: When I started ARVs while on TB treatment, my symptoms got worse before they got better.
sesotho_text: Ha ke qala ho noa li-ARV ke ntse ke le phekolong ea lefuba (TB), matšoao a ka a ile a mpefala pele a ka loka.

english_text: I lost my hearing in one ear from the TB injections, and that has been very difficult to accept.
sesotho_text: Ke ile ka lahleheloa ke kutlo tsebeng e le 'ngoe ka baka la liente tsa lefuba (TB), 'me ho bile thata haholo ho amohela seo.

english_text: My skin turned dark from the TB tablets, and people in my community asked questions.
sesotho_text: Letlalo la ka le ile la fetoha le letšo ka baka la lipilisi tsa lefuba (TB), 'me batho ba sechaba sa heso ba ne ba botsa lipotso.

english_text: I was on TB treatment for almost two years — it was the hardest thing I have ever done.
sesotho_text: Ke bile phekolong ea lefuba (TB) hoo e ka bang lilemo tse peli — e bile ntho e thata ka ho fetisisa eo ke kileng ka e etsa.

english_text: The nurse at the TB clinic always encouraged me and told me I was doing well.
sesotho_text: Mooki oa tleliniking ea lefuba (TB) o ne a lula a nkhothatsa 'me a mpolella hore ke tsoela pele hantle.

english_text: I did not tell my employer I had TB because I was afraid of losing my job.
sesotho_text: Ha kea ka ka bolella mohapi oa ka hore ke na le lefuba (TB) hobane ke ne ke tšaba ho lahleheloa ke mosebetsi.

english_text: I am now a TB treatment supporter for others in my community because I know how hard it is.
sesotho_text: Hona joale ke mosebeletsi ea tšehetsang phekolo ea lefuba (TB) bakeng sa ba bang sechabeng sa heso, hobane ke tseba hore na ho thata hakae.

english_text: New TB vaccine candidates are in clinical trials and may improve on the protection offered by BCG.
sesotho_text: Liente tse ncha tse lekoang tsa lefuba (TB) li mehatong ea liteko tsa meriana, 'me li ka khona ho ntlafatsa tšireletso e fanoang ke BCG.

english_text: The M72/AS01E vaccine candidate showed 50% efficacy against active TB in a phase 2b trial.
sesotho_text: Moemeli oa ente ea M72/AS01E o bontšitse katleho ea karolo ea mashome a mahlano lekholong (50%) khahlanong le lefu la lefuba le mafolofolo (active TB) tekong ea boemo ba 2b.

english_text: Shorter TB treatment regimens are being developed to improve adherence and reduce side effects.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a khutšoanyane a phekolo ea lefuba (TB) a ntse a hlahisoa ho ntlafatsa ho khomarela phekolo le ho fokotsa litlamorao tsa meriana.

english_text: Host-directed therapies aim to enhance the immune response to TB bacteria alongside antibiotic treatment.
sesotho_text: Litlhare tse lebisitsoeng ho moamoheli (Host-directed therapies) li ikemiselitse ho matlafatsa tšireletso ea mmele khahlanong le baktheria ea lefuba (TB) hammoho le phekolo ea lithibela-mafu.

english_text: Artificial intelligence is being applied to TB diagnosis through automated sputum smear reading and chest X-ray analysis.
sesotho_text: Bohlale ba maiketsetso (AI) bo ntse bo sebelisoa tlhahlobong ea lefuba (TB) ka ho bala ka ho iketsa ha litšila tsa mathe (sputum smear) le ho hlahloba linepe tsa sefuba tsa X-ray

english_text: Biomarker research aims to identify blood-based tests that can predict TB progression and treatment response.
sesotho_text: Lipatlisiso tsa matšoao a thuto ea bophelo (Biomarker research) li ikemiselitse ho tseba liteko tse thehiloeng maling tse ka pakang ho tsoela pele ha lefuba (TB) le tsela eo mmele o arabang phekolo ka eona.

english_text: The TB research pipeline includes new drugs, diagnostics, and vaccines at various stages of development.
sesotho_text: Lenaneo la lipatlisiso tsa lefuba (TB research pipeline) le kenyelletsa meriana e mecha, lisebelisoa tsa tlhahlobo, le liente maemong a fapaneng a kholo.

english_text: Increased investment in TB research and development is urgently needed to meet End TB targets.
sesotho_text: Tsetelo e ekelitsoeng lipatlisisong le kholong ea lefuba (TB) e hlokahala ka potlako ho fihlela lipheo tsa ho Felisa Lefuba (End TB targets).

english_text: Community engagement in TB research ensures that studies address the priorities of affected populations.
sesotho_text: Ho nka karolo hoa sechaba lipatlisisong tsa lefuba (TB) ho netefatsa hore lithuto li rarolla lintho tse tlang pele bophelong ba batho ba amehileng.

english_text: Open access to TB research findings accelerates the translation of science into policy and practice.
sesotho_text: Phihlello e bulehileng ea liphetho tsa lipatlisiso tsa lefuba (TB) e akofisa ho fetoleloa hoa saense ho ba melaoana le mekhoa ea ts'ebetso.

english_text: The BCG vaccine is the only licensed vaccine against tuberculosis.
sesotho_text: Ente ea BCG ke eona feela ente e lumelletsoeng ka molao ho loantša lefu la lefuba (TB).

english_text: BCG vaccination is given to newborns in most high TB burden countries at birth.
sesotho_text: Ente ea BCG e fanoa ho maseea a sa tsoa tswaloa linaheng tse ngata tse nang le moroalo o moholo oa lefuba (TB) hang ha ba tswaloa

english_text: BCG vaccination protects infants and young children against severe forms of TB including TB meningitis and miliary TB.
sesotho_text: Ente ea BCG e ts'ireletsa maseea le bana ba banyenyane khahlanong le mefuta e kotsi ea lefuba (TB) ho kenyelletsoa le ho ruruha ha lera la boko ka lebaka la lefuba (TB meningitis) le lefuba le nametseng mmele oohle (miliary TB).

english_text: BCG provides variable protection against pulmonary TB in adults and its efficacy differs by geography.
sesotho_text: Ente ea BCG e fana ka tšireletso e fapaneng khahlanong le lefuba la matšafole (pulmonary TB) ho batho ba baholo, 'me katleho ea eona e fapana ho latela libaka tsa thuto ea mafatše (geography).

english_text: BCG vaccination leaves a small scar at the injection site, usually on the upper left arm.
sesotho_text: Ente ea BCG e siea lebali le lenyenyane moo e hlabiloeng teng, hangata letsohong le letšehali le kaholimo.

english_text: BCG is a live attenuated vaccine and should not be given to severely immunocompromised individuals.
sesotho_text: Ente ea BCG ke ente e entsoeng ka likokwana-hloko tse phelang tse fokolitsoeng (live attenuated vaccine), 'me ha ea lokela ho fanoa ho batho ba nang le tšireletso ea mmele e fokolang haholo (severely immunocompromised).
